items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: It was definitely the type of stuff Mahalia Jackson and them do it.

ctx.x: I looked down a few minutes.

Don't worry. Both of them were singers, and they both had very fine contralto voices. And it amazed me because they were singing a type of music I'd never heard before. It was definitely the type of stuff Mahalia Jackson and them do it. They were the same type of hymns, not as well done, of course. But they had a quiver in the way they would duck certain notes and flatten them that was amazing to me. It used to fascinate me. I'd be in the yard playing and I could hear them singing. They were watching me play…
